file_insights.key_content: Sessions 1-8+ documenting 5 phases of component extraction, with detailed subtask tracking and blocker resolutions
file_insights.changes: Added 582 lines documenting full project lifecycle from planning through verification attempts

file_insights.purpose: Structured plan for 18 subtasks across 5 phases with dependencies and verification strategy
file_insights.key_content: Phase structure with extraction targets (10 components), migration plan, cleanup requirements, and QA acceptance criteria

patterns_discovered.description: Work distributed across Planner (Sessions 1,6), Coder (Sessions 2-5, 7-8), attempting recovery through documentation and retry logic
Session 3 detected missing prerequisite files, dynamically created all missing components to unblock subsequent work
patterns_discovered.impact: Critical blocker resolved without external intervention

patterns_discovered.description: Sessions 5-7 repeatedly encountered 'directory not found' errors requiring cd to project root (../../../../) before running npm commands
patterns_discovered.impact: Caused multiple retry attempts for subtasks 5-1 and 5-2

patterns_discovered.description: All 10 extracted components follow React.FC + TypeScript interfaces + useMemo styling pattern consistent with existing codebase
Each phase verified TypeScript compilation before proceeding; Phase 5 runs tests and linter before final line-count verification
patterns_discovered.impact: Prevents propagation of errors across phases

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: File existence mismatch between plan and worktree
gotchas_discovered.description: Session 3: Implementation plan marked tasks complete, but actual component files didn't exist in worktree. Manifests as plan corruption issue where plan documents completion without actual code artifacts.
gotchas_discovered.solution_attempted: Recreated all missing components during Session 3 to satisfy prerequisites

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Working directory context lost across sessions
gotchas_discovered.description: Sessions 5-7: npm commands failed because working directory was worktree root instead of project root. Required cd ../../../../ for every npm command.
gotchas_discovered.solution_attempted: Added explicit directory navigation before running npm commands

gotchas_discovered.description: Session 6: implementation_plan.json contained only QA metadata, missing core phase structure and subtask definitions. Cause: overwritten during iterations.
gotchas_discovered.solution_attempted: Reconstructed from build-progress.txt documentation; no version control rollback available

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: GameScreen.tsx line count target not met
gotchas_discovered.description: Subtask 5-3 objective: reduce GameScreen.tsx to under 400 lines. Session 4 reported 573 lines (45% reduction), still 143 lines above target despite successful component extraction and migration.
gotchas_discovered.solution_attempted: Subtask marked FAILED; blocker documented as 'Cannot verify line count reduction goal'

gotchas_discovered.description: Build-progress.txt truncated at Session 8 (45,553 chars), making final session outcome unclear. Multiple 'FAILED' attempt markers with pending status without closure explanation.

approach_outcome.critical_failure: Subtask 5-3 failed: GameScreen.tsx remains 573 lines, target was <400 lines. Despite extracting 10 components and migrating GameScreen, line count reduction goal not achieved.
key_accomplishments: Successfully extracted 10 reusable components following established patterns
Migrated GameScreen.tsx from 1054 lines to 573 lines (45% reduction)
All 244 tests passed with no regressions
TypeScript compilation verified at multiple checkpoints
Recovered from plan corruption and missing file prerequisites
blocking_issues: GameScreen.tsx line count still 143 lines above target (573 vs <400 goal)
Unknown cause for line count gap despite complete component extraction
No analysis of why extracted components didn't achieve target line count
Subtask 5-3 lacks root cause investigation or mitigation attempts

recommendations.recommendation: Investigate why GameScreen.tsx is 573 lines vs target of <400. Analyze: (1) Are components still being imported/used inefficiently? (2) Did extraction miss inline component definitions? (3) Is there duplicated code? (4) Should target be re-evaluated?
recommendations.rationale: Subtask 5-3 failed without explanation; 143-line gap suggests fundamental issue with extraction strategy or target setting

recommendations.recommendation: Implement persistent working directory context in multi-session orchestration. Store cwd as environment variable or session state rather than relying on relative paths that break across sessions.
recommendations.rationale: Sessions 5-7 wasted effort on directory navigation issues; consistent approach prevents retry loops

recommendations.recommendation: Add verification step after planner phase to confirm all prerequisite files exist before coder agent begins. Prevents Session 3 blocker pattern where plan completion doesn't correlate to actual artifacts.
recommendations.rationale: Gap between documented completion and actual file existence caused Session 3 blocker and Session 6 corruption

recommendations.recommendation: Require detailed failure logs for FAILED subtasks including: attempted solutions, measured vs target values, debugging steps taken, and recommended next actions. Currently subtask 5-3 failure lacks closure.
recommendations.rationale: Build-progress.txt truncates at failure point without explaining why target wasn't met or how to fix

recommendations.recommendation: Implement version control checkpoints for implementation_plan.json to prevent corruption. Use git hooks or locking mechanism to prevent overwrites during QA iterations.
recommendations.rationale: Session 6 had to recover plan from secondary documentation source; primary source was corrupted

recommendations.recommendation: Add automated metric collection to verify component extraction achieved intended goals: (1) lines removed from source file, (2) lines added in new components, (3) reusability index (how many places import each component), (4) cyclomatic complexity reduction
recommendations.rationale: Extracted 10 components but still missed line count target; metrics would reveal where extraction didn't achieve efficiency goals

recommendations.recommendation: Implement session summary template that captures final state, blockers encountered, and handoff notes. Sessions 1-8 show good granularity but lack consistent closure patterns.
recommendations.rationale: Truncated build-progress.txt makes it unclear if Session 8 produced any progress or actionable next steps
